title: Six-point consistency and uniqueness of the Veneziano amplitude
summary: We establish uniqueness of the Veneziano four-point amplitude in a meromorphic class by combining six-point consistency with a known low-order supersymmetry relation. We consider planar tree-level scattering in four dimensions with a massless maximally supersymmetric vector multiplet and an additional scalar parity condition. A difference of supersymmetry Ward identities isolates massless factorization residues and eliminates every permitted contribution regular in a common kinematic limit. The resulting functional equation holds at every derivative order and fixes all angular dependence…
